review_output: {"summary":"Migration 116 closes the RR/mixed-isolation link race that review 115 marked as a BLOCKER, for the schedules the test covers. The no-op metadata UPDATE now takes a real write on the payment row. An RR or Serializable payment writer whose snapshot predates the relink fails with 40001/P2034. An RC writer re-reads the row after the relink and sees the new link. The real-DB evidence shows all 18 isolation pairs and the RR regression passing, with stale-snapshot aborts as expected. row_security=off on the lock function addresses part of the RLS finding. Still not ready: the deadlock order and the populated upgrade tests are unfinished, the original 20/20 Serializable gate (2 attempts) is open, the upgrade window is still exposed, and some payment-path regressions are not covered by evidence. Dependency disputes are called out in finding 5.","findings":[{"severity":"MAJOR","confidence":0.75,"area":"deadlock/lock order","file":"prisma/migrations/20261016040000_live_metric_order_payment_write_fence/migration.sql","issue":"FOR SHARE was upgraded to an exclusive tuple write. Two order transactions on the same payment now serialize at the payment row after each already holds its own order row lock.","evidence":"Lines 24-25 replace the 115 FOR SHARE. The relink and restore helpers touch two orders in opposite order (order row, then payment row, then the other order row).","impact":"Deadlocks get more likely: transaction 1 holds order 1 and the payment; transaction 2 holds order 2 and waits for the payment; transaction 1 then updates order 2. This adds to the open deadlock-order finding.","recommended_fix":"Before the first order write, lock affected order rows and then payments in a canonical order, or document and retry 40P01. Finish the deadlock test.","required_test":"Run relink and restore concurrently at every isolation pair. Expect at most one 40P01 or 40001 and success on retry, with no lost window event."},{"severity":"MAJOR","confidence":0.55,"area":"payment-path regression / dependency gap","file":"prisma/migrations/20261016040000_live_metric_order_payment_write_fence/migration.sql","issue":"Linking, unlinking, inserting or deleting an order now writes the payment row.
